notes: Rights-offering prospectus (Rule 424(b)(1), dated March 4, 2021) for Tekla World Healthcare Fund (NYSE: THW). max_new_shares is the base 10,077,635 shares; the excerpt also states the Trust may add up to 25% (2,519,409 shares, 12,597,044 total) for over-subscription, which is not in max_new_shares. The subscription price is 95% of the NYSE VWAP over the expiry date and the four preceding trading days, floored at 90% of NAV; the $17.00 Estimated Subscription Price is an illustration as of February 26, 2021 and is not recorded as a term. Expiration is April 6, 2021 unless extended, and no later date is stated in the excerpt. Results fields are not in this excerpt.
